statuses: Burn
Loses 1/16 max HP each turn; physical damage halved. Ember types are immune.
Poison
Loses 1/8 max HP each turn. Venom and Metal types are immune.
Bad poison
Loses 1/16, then 2/16, 3/16... each turn; resets on switching. Same immunities as Poison.
Paralysis
Speed halved; 25% chance each turn to be unable to move. Volt types are immune.
Sleep
Cannot move for 1–3 turns. Sleep-only moves can still be used.
Frostbite
Loses 1/16 max HP each turn; special damage halved. Frost types are immune. Replaces the classic freeze.
Confusion (volatile)
2–5 turns; 33% chance each turn to hit itself with a 40-power typeless attack.
Flinch (volatile)
Loses its move this turn. Only works if the attacker moved first.
Trapped (volatile)
Cannot switch out; some traps deal 1/8 max HP each turn.
Seeded (volatile)
Loses 1/8 max HP each turn to the seeder.
Goaded (volatile)
Can only use damaging moves for 3 turns.
